name: claude-harness
description: Install a battle-tested Claude Code harness (skills + hooks + rules + sub-agents + memory) into any project, query the harness's own knowledge corpus over BM25, and dry-run scaffold plans — same model, 2x output.
author: Naman Parikh <naman10parikh@gmail.com>

mcp_servers.name: claude-harness
mcp_servers.description: claude-harness's own MCP server (stdio JSON-RPC): BM25 memory search over the repo corpus, tier listing, and dry-run scaffold planning via the real installer.

skills.description: On-demand slash-command workflows the scaffolder installs into .claude/skills/ (self-improve, architect, deep-think, troubleshoot, ...).

hooks.description: Lifecycle shell scripts (session-start context load, pre-compact memory flush, post-compact restore, stop-verify, session-end log, audit-log) wired via templates/settings.local.json.

commands.description: Slash commands for operating this repo (/start, /status, /wrap-up, /handoff, /validate, ...).

rules.description: Context-aware rule files auto-loaded by glob match (code-quality, git-discipline, language rules).

agents.description: Sub-agent definitions (code-reviewer, test-writer, research-agent, ...) installed to .claude/agents/.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: BM25 search over claude-harness's own knowledge corpus (brain/, docs/, memory/, identity/, MEMORY.md). Returns top scored paragraph chunks with file:line.
tools.when_to_use: When you need prior decisions, harness conventions, or learnings from this repo's own memory instead of re-deriving them.

tools.name: list_tiers
tools.description: List the scaffolder's tiers (starter/pro/expert) and exactly what each installs (skill/hook/rule counts, memory).
tools.when_to_use: When choosing which harness tier to install into a project.

tools.name: scaffold_plan
tools.description: Dry-run plan: report exactly what files a scaffold install would produce for a given tier/language/projectType (runs the real installer into a throwaway temp dir).
tools.when_to_use: Before running `claude-harness init`, to preview the exact file footprint without touching the target project.

install_instructions:
1. No build step (plain Node ESM, zero external deps for the server).
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select this directory.
3. The memory_search, list_tiers, and scaffold_plan tools are now available in any Claude Code session.
4. CLI equivalents: `claude-harness memory-search <query>` and `claude-harness sandbox-run`.
